# undatum

Command-line tool for converting, validating, querying, and documenting datasets across 140+ formats (iterabledata), Entry points: `undatum` and `data`. `-` reads stdin; results go to stdout in the input's format (`-O` to change).

Site: https://datenoio.github.io/undatum/
CLI help: `undatum <command> --help`

## Getting started

- [Installation](https://datenoio.github.io/undatum/getting-started/installation) — extras, uv/pipx, Python 3.10+
- [Quick start](https://datenoio.github.io/undatum/getting-started/quick-start)
- [Cookbook](https://datenoio.github.io/undatum/getting-started/cookbook)
- [Basic usage](https://datenoio.github.io/undatum/getting-started/basic-usage) — `--filter` syntax, encoding, compression
- [Shared CLI options](https://datenoio.github.io/undatum/commands/shared-options) — `--format-in`/`-F`, `--format-out`/`-O`, `--limit`/`-n`, `--where`, `--add`, `--flatten-nested`, `--on-error`, `--error-log`, `--table`, `--quotechar`
- [JSON output](https://datenoio.github.io/undatum/commands/json-output) — `--json` documents with a versioned `schema` id; JSON errors on stderr
- [Performance](https://datenoio.github.io/undatum/getting-started/performance)
- [Troubleshooting](https://datenoio.github.io/undatum/getting-started/troubleshooting) — exit codes 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 130
- [Migrating to 2.0](https://datenoio.github.io/undatum/getting-started/migrating-to-2) — deprecated commands and options; `undatum migrate-script` rewrites them

## Commands

- [Command index](https://datenoio.github.io/undatum/commands/)
- [convert](https://datenoio.github.io/undatum/commands/convert) — `--where`, `--add`, `--partition-by` (Hive layout)
- [repack](https://datenoio.github.io/undatum/commands/repack)
- [formats](https://datenoio.github.io/undatum/commands/formats)
- [analyze](https://datenoio.github.io/undatum/commands/analyze)
- [stats](https://datenoio.github.io/undatum/commands/stats)
- [select](https://datenoio.github.io/undatum/commands/select) — `--filter` (alias `--filter-expr`)
- [validate](https://datenoio.github.io/undatum/commands/validate)
- [Validation rules](https://datenoio.github.io/undatum/commands/validate-rules) — rule file catalogue (`format:`, `unique:`, `references:`)
- [quality](https://datenoio.github.io/undatum/commands/quality) — data quality report with thresholds (exit 1 on failure)
- [schema](https://datenoio.github.io/undatum/commands/schema)
- [schema-drift](https://datenoio.github.io/undatum/commands/schema-drift) — compare deliveries with a baseline; `diff --schema` for two files
- [sql](https://datenoio.github.io/undatum/commands/sql)
- [pipeline](https://datenoio.github.io/undatum/commands/pipeline) — YAML DSL, templates including `jsonl-normalization`
- [apply](https://datenoio.github.io/undatum/commands/apply) — `--script` or `--plugin`
- [db](https://datenoio.github.io/undatum/commands/db) — query, load (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, ClickHouse, SQL Server, MongoDB, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch), dump
- [api](https://datenoio.github.io/undatum/commands/api)
- [ai](https://datenoio.github.io/undatum/commands/ai) — `ai plan SOURCE TARGET` (two paths, not `--to`)
- [doc](https://datenoio.github.io/undatum/commands/doc)
- [mcp](https://datenoio.github.io/undatum/commands/mcp)
- [tui](https://datenoio.github.io/undatum/commands/tui) / [web](https://datenoio.github.io/undatum/commands/web)
- [config](https://datenoio.github.io/undatum/commands/config)
- [plugins](https://datenoio.github.io/undatum/commands/plugins)
- [extract](https://datenoio.github.io/undatum/commands/extract) — `undatum[extract]`
- [package](https://datenoio.github.io/undatum/commands/package)
- [migrate-script](https://datenoio.github.io/undatum/commands/migrate-script) — rewrite deprecated commands and options in scripts

## Integrations

- [MCP server and tool catalog](https://datenoio.github.io/undatum/integrations/mcp) — one tool per operation, resources `undatum://datasets`, prompts
- [Python SDK](https://datenoio.github.io/undatum/integrations/sdk) — lazy `Dataset` plans: read/from_records, select, filter, sort, dedup, join, rename, fill, sample, mask, ...; terminal methods write, collect, count, stats, quality, validate, explain
- [Python SDK reference](https://datenoio.github.io/undatum/integrations/sdk-reference) — generated from docstrings
- [Data API](https://datenoio.github.io/undatum/integrations/data-api) — optional `--api-key` / `UNDATUM_API_KEY`, sent as the `X-API-Key` header
- [Cloud storage](https://datenoio.github.io/undatum/integrations/cloud) — `s3://`, `gs://`, `az://`
- [Plugins](https://datenoio.github.io/undatum/integrations/plugins)
- [AI documentation](https://datenoio.github.io/undatum/integrations/ai)
